latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of K-Pop Idol Generator.

- Generate K-pop idol style portraits and photocard aesthetic images from any prompt.
- Supports custom image size options: portrait, landscape, square, tall.
- Allows style inheritance using a reference image UUID.
- Requires a Neta API token (free trial available).
- Simple command-line usage for generating images.
